name: GC pressure meter
description: Vertical gauge showing managed heap fill against committed memory. Pick the application; the widget binds to dotnet.gc.last_collection.heap.size and dotnet.gc.last_collection.memory.committed_size and color-shifts past 70% / 90%.

spec.template:
{{ percent heap.value 0 committed.value }}% of committed
Heap{{ format heap.value 'bytes' 1 }}
Committed{{ format committed.value 'bytes' 1 }}
spec.styles: .gcm { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem; height: 100%; align-items: stretch; } .gcm svg { height: 100%; max-height: 14rem; flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--color-graphite-500); } .gcm .track { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 8%, transparent); stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 22%, transparent); stroke-width: 1; } .gcm .zone-warn { fill: var(--color-amber-500); } .gcm .zone-bad { fill: var(--color-rust-500); } .gcm .fill { fill: var(--color-sage-500); transition: y 600ms ease-out; } .gcm .fill.vellum-th-warn { fill: var(--color-amber-500); } .gcm .fill.vellum-th-bad  { fill: var(--color-rust-500); } .gcm .bulb { fill: var(--color-sage-500); stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 30%, transparent); stroke-width: 1; } .gcm .bulb.vellum-th-warn { fill: var(--color-amber-500); } .gcm .bulb.vellum-th-bad  { fill: var(--color-rust-500); } .gcm .lbls { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; justify-content: center; } .gcm .headline { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.05rem; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; } .gcm .headline strong { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; } .gcm .headline strong.vellum-th-ok   { color: var(--color-sage-600); } .gcm .headline strong.vellum-th-warn { color: var(--color-amber-600); } .gcm .headline strong.vellum-th-bad  { color: var(--color-rust-600); } .gcm .headline .sub { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--color-graphite-500); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .gcm .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.78rem; } .gcm .k { font-size: 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--color-graphite-500); } .gcm .v { font-weight: 500; }
